name: are-coach-functions
comment-overrides: Patch-level pins for transitive CVEs, all same-major and therefore safe. websocket-driver 0.7.5 clears a CRITICAL resource-limit bypass reaching us through firebase-admin's Realtime Database client (firebase-admin -> @firebase/database-compat -> faye-websocket); we use Firestore, not RTDB, but the package still ships in the deployed bundle. express/body-parser/qs are the web-facing request-parsing chain from firebase-functions -- body-parser and qs were re-pinned (1.20.5 -> 1.20.8, 6.15.2 -> 6.16.0) when fresh advisories landed on the versions previously pinned here, which is exactly why the line below says to re-check. The 8 remaining moderates are one internal GCP-SDK chain (uuid -> gaxios/teeny-request/retry-request -> google-gax -> @google-cloud/* -> firebase-admin); npm's only 'fix' is downgrading firebase-admin to 10.3.0, an OLDER and worse-patched major. Left until Google bumps them upstream. Re-check with `npm audit` before each release -- a clean audit last month does not mean a clean audit today.
